set: A: motion, one sheet of frames spread across each of the page's ten beats

issues.where: the spider machine, every frame 2:11.90 to 2:15.97 (also across set-A-04)
issues.what: it glides back and forth across the page at an even speed with its legs dangling and only a soft blob shadow; no foot ever visibly plants and the body never shifts weight, so the machine reads as a prop being slid by hand, not a thing with mass
issues.fix: give the walk discrete planted steps with a pause and body dip on each plant, tighten the contact shadow under the planted feet, and vary its speed so it starts and stops rather than drifting

issues.where: frames 1:55.07 and 1:55.43, the Submit button and the cursor
issues.what: the button cracks and tips while the cursor is a hand's width away to its left; in no shown frame does the cursor touch the button, so the hit reads as remote activation
issues.fix: show the frame where the cursor point meets the button face, with the button dipping under it in the same frame, before the cracks spread

issues.what: without a caption it is unclear who is firing at whom: the glowing trail runs from near the cursor to the machine's face in some frames and blooms on the machine's mouth in others as if the machine itself is sparking; only the later explosion resolves it
issues.fix: anchor the beam's source to the cursor tip in every frame and keep the hit flash on the machine's hull, offset from its mouth

issues.where: frame 1:54.73, mid-page left of the Submit button
issues.what: a small white fragmented shape floats mid-page with no readable identity; it does not connect to the cursor in the frames before or after, so it reads as a stray artifact
issues.fix: if it is the cursor mid-transition, hold one continuous silhouette through the morph; otherwise remove it
